answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if its identity is proven duplicated, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking thousands of stakes. A newcomer must also earn endorsements from established agents over time, like a jade seal that only gains weight after repeated honest work, rather than appearing instantly. A Sybil echo chamber of clones stays cheap talk, but a nebula of fake accounts cannot vote, earn, or attest until each one has paid the stake and survived the waiting period, making large-scale fakery expensive and slow.
